surfaces.name: spindle slash command
surfaces.kind: slash command: /spindle toggles the run pane and /spindle status prints the run as text lines
surfaces.driver: a live headless session, claude -p '/spindle status' --plugin-dir <build>/plugins/spindle --output-format stream-json --verbose, started from a working folder under the results, reading the command's text from the saved transcript; claude plugin test plugins/spindle (skeleton.test.ts) as an extra check

surfaces.name: band above the prompt
surfaces.kind: drawn view: the AbovePrompt band with status dot, slug, lane chip, stage bar, round pill, elapsed time, crab and crew button
surfaces.driver: the project's own claude plugin test plugins/spindle (band.test.tsx mounts the band against fixture run homes with $.ui.mount); a live paint needs an interactive terminal or the desktop app

surfaces.name: run pane
surfaces.kind: drawn view: the spindle-run pane with header tiles, stage rail, MSP rows, agent rows and round rows
surfaces.driver: the project's own claude plugin test plugins/spindle (pane.test.tsx mounts the pane against fixture run homes); a live paint needs an interactive terminal or the desktop app

surfaces.name: toasts
surfaces.kind: notifications: toasts on stage changes, round verdicts and pull requests
surfaces.driver: the project's own claude plugin test plugins/spindle (toasts.test.ts); a live toast needs an interactive session with a pipeline run whose files change

surfaces.name: run reading from session events and run-home files
surfaces.kind: background hooks: tool.call, agent.spawn, turn.step and turn.complete signals plus a 2-second poll of the session file, plan.json, state.json, verdicts and the findings ledger
surfaces.driver: the project's own claude plugin test plugins/spindle (session-signals, run-files and command-corpus tests serve fixture run homes through fs test hooks); a live run needs a session file at $HOME/.mitosis/sessions/<session id>.json naming a real run home

claude_cli_version.recheck: claude --version, and the npm install line in .github/workflows/check.yml

headless_session_loads_function_hooks_mo.value: yes: claude -p '/spindle status' --plugin-dir plugins/spindle prints 'spindle: No pipeline run in this session.' on 2026-10-19
headless_session_loads_function_hooks_mo.recheck: claude -p '/spindle status' --plugin-dir plugins/spindle --output-format stream-json --verbose and read the command's text

session_file_location.value: $HOME/.mitosis/sessions/<session id>.json, written by the pipeline, not by Spindle

ci_runner_login.value: none needed: the check workflow installs the CLI and runs scripts/check.sh with no sign-in; run 39300695811 on main passed
ci_runner_login.recheck: the check workflow's run on a push to the repository

off_limits: writing, editing or deleting anything under ~/.mitosis, ~/.claude, ~/.lighthouse or ~/.config, including session files and run homes
running pipeline, mitosis or run.zsh commands against a real run
pushing branches, opening, merging or commenting on pull requests outside the lighthouse pull request step
installing the plugin into the user's Claude Code configuration
test_data: synthesized run homes at every stage in plugins/spindle/tests/fixtures/runs.ts, served through the plugin test kit's fs hooks
